clips.title: The story
paras: In Cathedral Square, faith and civic life meet beneath the Cathedral of Light. City Hall, the orphanage, and the Argent Dawn's Stormwind headquarters all stand here.

Northwest of the Trade District and southeast of the Dwarven District, Cathedral Square draws the faithful from across the Kingdom of Stormwind. The Cathedral of Light rises above it, the foremost sanctuary of the Holy Light across Azeroth. Priests, paladins, and healers come to study, pray, and train. Citizens and pilgrims mingle with local schoolchildren, led by School Mistress Danna, in the square.

Prayer shares the district with the work of the kingdom. City Hall and the Stormwind Orphanage anchor its civic life. Along the avenues, armorers and weaponsmiths serve holy crusaders, including Righteous Plates and Just Maces. The Argent Dawn keeps its Stormwind base here, where recruiters and representatives coordinate relief efforts and rally champions against the Scourge in the northern kingdoms.
